title: Material Blend 3-Mix Solo #08 (대각 띠·매끈 | 스테인드글라스+목재+나비날개비늘)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, late 20s goddess, amazon bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — impossibly tall commanding frame with simultaneously the most massive full-figure curves, enormous powerful presence dominating the entire frame top to bottom, legs endlessly long massively thick and powerful, two thick goddess braids — her body carries 3 different materials at once, each claiming its own region of her figure. Her figure is divided into 3 diagonal bands by 2 parallel hazy transition zones running from the upper left to the lower right as seen by the camera, crossing the centre line of her figure about 35% of the way down her figure from the top and about 56% of the way down her figure from the top. Region 1 is everything on the upper side of the first diagonal transition zone: it carries solid thick stained glass fused to her form, hundreds of small individual panes each no larger than a coin, BLAZING ELECTRIC EMERALD and VIVID GOLD panes alternating in a dense irregular mosaic, dark lead-line seams webbing between every pane. Region 2 is the diagonal band between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it carries rich dark walnut wood fused directly into her own form, natural grain lines flowing to follow every curve, BLAZING deep warm-brown grain with VIVID honey-gold highlight streaks. Region 3 is everything on the lower side of the last diagonal transition zone: it carries butterfly scales (thousands of microscopic powder-fine scales layered like overlapping roof tiles, each scale individually distinct catching its own glint), BLAZING ELECTRIC EMERALD scale formations, VIVID GOLD scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. The boundaries between regions are hazy and feathered — there is no visible line at all. Each transition zone is about a hand's width wide, and across it the neighbouring materials dissolve into each other, elements from one thinning out as elements from the other appear, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, never a hard edge. Each transition zone follows a smooth, even, straight course. Even inside a transition zone the skin is never left bare: at every point one material, or a mixture of the two, fully covers it, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere, every material fused to or erupting from her own living skin, covering her completely with no bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Pose: full frontal, both hands framing the face, chin raised, every region clearly visible to the camera — most extreme amazon bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
extreme platform heels/boots blending the relevant materials at her feet, extra long nails each matching whichever region that hand falls in.

MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every material and every blended transition. Pattern density MAXIMUM — zero bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
